title: Current-group position configuration owns flight position lists

expectation.example: Owner screenshots show TR121 template position text independently editable despite detailed position configuration. Owner approved: A has H02/H03 and B only H02; template shows the active group list, while flight number/time/remark remain shared.
expectation.expected: Remove manual template position input. Derive ordered unique position names from current-group positionRules for template display, weekly/template picker counts, all three schedule preparations, new current flights and config XLSX position columns. Changes, deletion and sorting in position config propagate automatically; template input/import cannot reconstruct deleted rules or change other-group rules. XLSX and storage reload preserve group isolation.
expectation.unchanged: No new scheduling rule: actual task generation already uses activeFlightRules. Flight numbers, times, remarks, passenger counts, weekly selections, history and qualifications remain unchanged except existing position-edit invalidation. Historical pre-v10/v11 migration contracts are preserved. Existing Flight/FlightTemplate positions arrays remain transfer snapshots, never an alternative owner of current configuration.
expectation.fallback: Missing rules show no configured positions, never fall back to stale template/flight snapshots. Template-only imports update flight metadata without guessing or adding group positions. Manual edit commands for obsolete position inputs are rejected without writes. Import validation and cancellation protect existing data.

review.missedScope: Traced all source .positions consumers. Current UI, controller preparation, additions/rename and config export use the single projection. Historical snapshots and pre-v10/v11 migration deliberately remain; tests prove group isolation. Physical device pair and all narrow viewports not manually retested.
review.rootCause: Actual schedule tasks used positionRules but template/UI/candidate/export lists consumed shared editable snapshots, while import rebuilt group rules from those snapshots. This task replaces that ownership contract with owner-approved group-specific derivation.
review.earlyDetection: Before changing shared config, list all .positions producers/consumers and exercise A/B with different jobs plus deleted jobs and stale snapshots, then inspect real exported rows independently before actual-page acceptance.
